si_3_author_journal_year: Jiang A et al., Psychological Medicine, 2024
si_4_title: Age-atypical brain functional networks in autism spectrum disorder: a normative modeling approach

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: A multi-site dataset (17 centers) providing resting-state fMRI and behavioral scores for 1495 individuals initially, with 1218 (642 TD, 576 ASD) included after quality control and exclusion of left-handed participants.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The ABIDE dataset is a large-scale open-access neuroimaging dataset for ASD, which currently includes resting-state fMRI data from 1495 individuals collected at 17 data acquisition centers.

answer.ABIDE: normative training/testing (TD), patient for clinical research (ASD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The TD cohort from ABIDE was used to establish the normative developmental trajectories of functional connectivity using LOESS regression. The ASD cohort was used to evaluate individual deviations (atypicality) from these norms.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: NM not only yields the predicted FC for each subject but also produces the normative mean and standard deviation from the TD group. These statistical norms were then used to compute the Z ' -scores of each functional connection and the W -scores of each brain network for each patient with ASD
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Jiang2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Constructing age-related normative models

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: 642 TD individuals were used as the normative sample to estimate age-specific means and standard deviations using local polynomial regression (LOESS).
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.supporting_text: After exclusion, the sample size was 642 for the TD group and 576 for the ASD group.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Age characteristics for the 642 TD individuals used to build the normative model. Mean and SD are rounded to two decimal places from the values in Table 1 (Mean 15.34, SD 8.033).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: Table 1. Sample characteristics after normative modeling selection ... Age TD Mean 15.34 ... N 642 ... S.D. 8.033 ... Minimum 5 ... Maximum 40 ... Median 13

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The study reports an approximate 5:1 male-to-female ratio for the whole sample. Based on this ratio, the counts for the TD group (N=642) are estimated as 107 females and 535 males.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.reason: The exact counts for female and male participants in the TD group are not explicitly stated, but the paper mentions an approximate 5:1 male-to-female ratio in the Discussion. Assuming this ratio applies to the TD cohort of 642: Female = 642 / 6 = 107; Male = 642 - 107 = 535. Percentages are calculated accordingly (107/642 ≈ 16.7%).
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: it also has few female participants, with a male-to-female ratio of approximately 5:1. Conclusions regarding female participants lack corresponding evidence...
